notes.title: Version 1.01 released: various bug fixes/tweaks
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A few people have mentioned issues regarding collisions and the controls feeling slightly too slippery.  Most of the issues seemed to be in levels 1-2 and 1-3.

I just released a patch that addresses those concerns.  This patch affects both Windows and Linux builds.


Changes:

- Increased friction a bit, so the player stops more quickly, allowing more precise platforming

- Adjusted collision boxes of various walls and spikes that were causing trouble

notes.title: Easter egg: 2-player mode
notes.content:
Just connect a second controller, and press the Jump button on it during a level.  A second player will be able to play as the Bootworm from the Bootworm Racing minigame.

This can be especially useful for the tougher trophies, like "Low-Level Run" or "Remix Mode complete".

The Bootworm is invincible, so although it only deals a little damage at a time, it can help give you a slight edge in boss battles and tough levels.

notes.title: Official strategy guide now available (for free!)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I've written a strategy guide for Emerald Shores ahead of the game's release.

This guide will show you the locations of all of the hidden items in the game.  It also tells you how to unlock the many secret levels, minigames and sidequests.

If you're struggling with a boss battle, it also gives some pointers on those.

Link to strategy guide:

http://www.fordesoft.com/strategy-guides/emerald-shores/cover

Hope you enjoy the game. :)
